title: The side hustle that replaced my 9 to 5 in 30 days

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if a side hustle, powered by AI, could replace your 9-to-5 in just 30 days?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI tools like automated content creation and smart contract platforms now generate income with minimal input.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this risks job displacement, inequality, and the erosion of traditional career paths and social safety nets.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are developing platforms that upskill users, ensuring they remain valuable in an AI-driven economy.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI handles routine tasks, freeing humans for creative and strategic work.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about replacement—it’s about redefining value, purpose, and work itself.

video_cue: A person working on a laptop with AI-generated reports and income graphs appearing on the screen.
